events.body:
## Context

BLT-GSOC (`blt-gsoc/`) is rated **Bronze** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-gsoc): it meets 93% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Bronze (the basics: a README, a description, a licence and a logo)

- **Licence file.** Add a LICENSE file to the folder (most BLT projects are AGPL-3.0; copy the repository root's LICENSE).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Licence file
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-gsoc` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-gsoc
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-gsoc
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
